title: Canton Brothers Rubber Factory - Tai-Kung Strike Of Female Workers

page_data.en:
6584
March 16, 1935. 16. 3. 35.

Labour

Canton Brothers Rubber Factory - "Tai-kung" strike
of female workers

700 female workers of the Canton Brothers Rubber
Factory, 470 Baikal Road, went on a "tai-kung" strike at
1 p.m. March 15, following an altercation with the male
hands over monopolization of the higher paid work by the
latter (Vide I.R. 15/3/35). The strike was called off
at 4 p.m. when a notice was posted by the Management
announcing that the material and work would be distributed
equally.

Ming Sung Cotton Mill - Unrest among workers

Some 100 workers of the Ming Sung Cotton Mill,
143 Warren Road, O.O.L. met in the office of the 10th
District Cotton Spinners' Union, 1428 Brenan Road, O.O.L.
at 2 p.m. March 15. It was decided that appeals be made
to the Chinese authorities for negotiation with the
management to reopen the mill, which closed down on March 6.

Lien Yih Association of the China Egg Produce
Factory Employees - new body formed

A new organization called the "Lien Yih Association
of the China Egg Produce Factory Employees", which has
recently came into existence, was inaugurated on March 11
in the Shanghai Municipality Wharf Employees' Guild, 178
Hung Tseng Village, in the presence of some 100 members.
A permit for the organization has been issued by the local
Kuomintang.

The China Egg Produce Factory, which is located
at 44 Whangpoo Road, employs some 145 workers.

1935年3月16日。1935年3月16日。

劳工

广生橡胶厂——女工“怠工”罢工

贝加尔路470号广生橡胶厂的700名女工于3月15日下午1时进行“怠工”罢工，此前她们因男工垄断高薪工作而与男工发生争执（参见1935年3月15日情报报告）。当管理层张贴公告宣布材料和工序将平均分配后，罢工于下午4时停止。

明松棉纺厂——工人骚动

3月15日下午2时，越界筑路区华伦路143号明松棉纺厂约100名工人在越界筑路区勃南路1428号第十区棉纺业工会办事处集会。会议决定向中方当局提出诉求，要求与管理层谈判以重新开工，该厂已于3月6日停工。

中国蛋品加工厂职工联益会——新团体成立

一个名为“中国蛋品加工厂职工联益会”的新组织近期成立，并于3月11日在虹镇路178号上海市码头工会举行成立典礼，约有100名成员出席。当地国民党部已为该组织颁发许可证。

位于黄浦路44号的中国蛋品加工厂雇佣约145名工人。

REPORT

Subject Strike at Canton Bros. Rubber Shoes Factory, 470 Baikal Road.

Made by D.S. 262 Davies. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
I beg to report with reference to the above at 8.30 a.m.
15/3/35 a telephone message was received from the factory
reporting that the workers were causing trouble.
The undersigned and C.D.S. 98 immediately attended and from
enquiries made the following was ascertained.
The employees at the above factory are engaged on piece
work and the rate of pay is divided into four classes according
to the grade of shoe manufactured.
Grade 1. One pair of shoes 4.6 cts. per pair.
" 2. " " " " 4.5 " " "
" 3. " " " " 3.4 " " "
" 4. " " " " 2.3 " " "
At 8.30 a.m. even date a dispute arose between the male
and female workers over the former manufacturing grade No. 1
& 2 and leaving grade No. 3 & 4 for the female workers to
make whereby the latter lost money.
The female workers demanded that the male workers should
share the work in making the better grade shoes but they
refused to do this and a quarrel ensued which later developed
into a fight during which the following persons were injured.
(1) Bar Ming Pao (侯明宝), male, 440 San Loh Li, Baikal Road.
(2) Lo Yuan Teh (罗元泰), male, 189 Kung Yu Li, Yangtsepoo Rd.
(3) Ling Lee Sz (林李氏), female, 3 Sz Zung Feng, Ward Road.
(4) Wo Yue Sz (胡月氏), female, Zung Zaur Li, Baikal Road.
The above persons were sent to the Sacred Heart Hospital
where they were treated and found to be suffering from injuries
detailed below.
(1) Small cut on the scalp, not serious and not detained.

报告

事由：贝加尔路470号广生兄弟橡胶鞋厂罢工。

呈报人：警探长262号戴维斯。转呈人：[签名]

先生：
谨就上述事项报告如下：1935年3月15日上午8时30分，接到工厂电话报告，称工人正在闹事。
卑职与刑事侦缉警探98号立即赶赴现场，经查询查明以下情况。
上述工厂的雇员从事计件工作，工资率根据所制造鞋子的等级分为四类。
一等：每双鞋4.6分。
二等：每双鞋4.5分。
三等：每双鞋3.4分。
四等：每双鞋2.3分。
同日早上8时30分，男女工人之间发生纠纷，起因是男工制造一、二等鞋，而将三、四等鞋留给女工制造，导致女工收入减少。
女工要求男工分担较高等级鞋类的制造工作，但男工拒绝，随即发生争吵，随后升级为斗殴，期间下列人员受伤。
(1) 侯明宝 (Bar Ming Pao)，男，贝加尔路三乐里440号。
(2) 罗元泰 (Lo Yuan Teh)，男，杨树浦路公裕里189号。
(3) 林李氏 (Ling Lee Sz)，女，华德路四众丰3号。
(4) 胡月氏 (Wo Yue Sz)，女，贝加尔路宗造里。
上述人员被送往圣心医院接受治疗，经查伤势如下。
(1) 头皮轻微割伤，不严重，未留院观察。

March 15, 1935.
Labour (3)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL ... No. D ... Date ____ /____）

Postal Workers - Meeting

Between 3.30 p.m. and 6 p.m. March 14, nineteen
members of the Postal Workers' Club held a meeting in
their office at Lane 538, No.9 Range Road, O.O.L., and
passed the following resolutions :-

1. That representatives be detailed to attend the
christening ceremony of an aeroplane subscribed for
by postal workers, which will be held at Nanking on
April 4.

2. That representations be made to the authorities for
the reinstatement of a junior clerk who resigned
some time ago owing to illness.

（批：Urgent）

Canton Brothers Rubber Factory - "Tai-kung" strike
called off

The "tai-kung" strike declared in the morning of
March 14 by the workers of the Canton Brothers/rubber Factory, 470
Baikal Road, was called off at 3 p.m. the same day,
following the action of the Management in readjusting the
rate of pay. According to this new rate, the wages will
be reduced by 0.5 to 1.9 cents instead of 2 cents per
article made.

At 8.30 a.m. to-day, March 15, an altercation
took place between the male and female hands of the
factory, arising out of the former selecting work for
which the rate of pay is higher. During the dispute three
male workers were injured. Work, however, is now
being carried on in a normal manner.

1935年3月15日。
劳工 (3)
（印：上海公共租界工部局 ... 编号 D ... 日期 ____ /____）

邮政工人——会议

3月14日下午3时30分至6时之间，邮政工人俱乐部的19名成员在越界筑路区兰恩路9号538弄的办公室举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1. 指派代表参加由邮政工人捐款购买的飞机的命名仪式，该仪式将于4月4日在南京举行。

2. 向当局提出交涉，要求复职一名不久前因病辞职的初级职员。

（批：紧急）

广生橡胶厂——“怠工”罢工停止

3月14日上午，贝加尔路470号广生兄弟橡胶厂工人宣布的“怠工”罢工，在管理层调整工资率后，于同日下午3时停止。根据新的工资率，每件产品的工资将减少0.5至1.9分，而非之前的2分。

今天，即3月15日上午8时30分，工厂男女工人之间发生争执，起因是男工挑选薪酬较高的工作。纠纷中有三名男工受伤。然而，目前工作正正常进行。

March 14, 1935.

Canton Brothers Rubber Factory - "Tai-kung" Strike

The 1,050 workers of the Canton Brothers' Rubber
Factory, 470 Baikal Road, declared a "tai-kung" strike at
9.30 a.m. to-day, March 14, being dissatisfied with an
announcement of the Management to reduce their rate of
pay by 2 cents per article made. They are further
demanding that the wages in arrears (about two months)
be issued.
